name: final_part2
_note: Part two of the Solana final film: real screens of 1 November 2026 (Aurora Intents on mainnet, the pay desk on devnet). Rendered by part2.html, assembled after dareskro_la_linea_solana.mp4 by make_final.mjs.

slides.small: 1 November 2026 · Aurora Intents on mainnet · the pay desk on Solana devnet
slides.say: Part two. What you just saw drawn, run for real on the first of November 2026.
slides.sub: Part two: the same story, run for real on 1 November 2026.

slides.title: Aurora Intents — dareskro's XRP Ledger account funds the Solana desk · mainnet
lines: USDC of the recipient : 0 → 3   (37 s after the quote, 0 refunded)
slides.say: First, the money arrives from another chain. dareskro's own XRP Ledger account pays two point six three XRP. Aurora Intents delivers exactly three USDC on Solana, in thirty-seven seconds. Mainnet, real funds, nothing mocked.
slides.sub: Aurora Intents, mainnet: 2.63 XRP leave dareskro's XRPL account, 3 USDC land on Solana in 37 s.

slides.title: livenet.xrpl.org — the payment, ledger 108 040 855
slides.say: The payment on the XRP Ledger, validated in ledger one hundred and eight million.
slides.sub: The XRPL half: 2.627332 XRP to Aurora's deposit address, tesSUCCESS, fee 12 drops.

slides.title: explorer.solana.com — the settlement, slot 464 012 735
slides.say: The USDC landing on Solana, slot four hundred sixty-four million, status success.
slides.sub: The Solana half: the settlement that credits 3.000000 USDC to the desk's address.

slides.title: The pay desk — a new tab: Solana · same desk
slides.say: Then the pay desk. The same application as on XRPL, with a new tab: the Solana rail. Employer, employee, oracle, and the rate from Aurora's own list.
slides.sub: The pay desk gains a tab. Same application, same statement, another ledger.

slides.title: Step 2 — the statement, computed by code, validated by a human
slides.say: The statement, computed by code line by line, validated by a human. Four hundred and forty dollars thirty-six.
slides.sub: Computed by code, replayable to the cent; validated by a human. Net to pay: 440.36 USD.

slides.title: Step 3 — funding from any chain
slides.say: A quote for exactly that amount in USDC, paid in XRP, twenty-four seconds. The live run sits right below it.
slides.sub: A real quote for 440.36 USDC paid in XRP, 24 s; the mainnet run is shown under it.

slides.title: Step 4 — the lock: create(finish_after), signed by the employer
slides.say: The lock. Four point six SOL in a program-derived account. Three memos: the statement's hash, the fiat line, the oracle's address. Payable in seventy-five seconds.
slides.sub: 4.6 SOL locked in a program-derived account. Memos: statement hash, fiat line, oracle. Payable in 75 s.

slides.title: Step 5 — three forbidden actions, refused on chain
slides.say: Three forbidden actions, each a real transaction the ledger keeps with its refusal. A passer-by releases early: too early. The employer takes it back: not cancellable. A passer-by pays himself: wrong destination.
slides.sub: Early release: TooEarly. Employer takes it back: NotCancellable. Pay yourself: WrongDestination. All recorded.

slides.title: The date passes — the oracle calls finish
slides.say: At the date, the oracle calls finish. Nobody clicked. The money goes where it was written.
slides.sub: 7 s after the date the oracle calls finish. Nobody clicked. 4.616 SOL now with the employee.

slides.title: Step 6 — the registry is the chain itself
slides.say: And the registry is the chain itself: every escrow of this employer, with the oracle's word next to it.
slides.sub: The registry is the chain: every escrow of this employer, and the oracle's word beside it.
